messages:
mira: quick idea  add a tiny 'snaplet' action in the timepicker to capture an event window and drop a slim vertical marker on the heatmap for direct p95 comparison across days. session-scoped by default, with an optional 'save comparison' permalink.

dylan: good. UX questions: how to create (click +, double-click range, keyboard)? defaults?

mira: propose small + inside picker + keyboard (Enter) when focused on range. ephemeral by default.

ash: sampling caveat: our reservoir sampling per bucket means p95 can jiggle if bucket boundaries shift. recommend showing a small "Sampled" chip on the latency card with hover showing sampling_rate and sampling_strategy. offer a "Run full scan" action behind a cost warning.

pei: accessibility: anchor creation must be keyboard reachable and announced via aria-live: "Anchor created: <label>". marker needs >=4.5:1 contrast and an accessible name. ensure tab order: timepicker -> anchors list -> chart.

tess: microcopy: button "Create snaplet" (alt: "Create anchor"); tooltip: "Capture this time window for quick comparison". sampled chip text: "Sampled view" with tooltip that shows % and link to docs.

access-bot: A11Y checklist:

 Anchor creation reachable by keyboard (Enter/Space).
 New anchor announced via aria-live.
 Marker color >= 4.5:1 contrast.
 Sampled chip has accessible label + tooltip.

mira: next steps: pei/tess to pair on color tokens + copy and produce a tiny figma frame. ash/dylan to confirm API fields (sampling_rate, sampling_strategy, anchor_mode=stream|full) and streaming plan. I'll schedule a 20m follow-up.

(emoji reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes:)
